svg.aria-label: A grid of speed-ups of the resident tiles over the fastest real software, for multiply, fused multiply-add and add, at four formats, on two machines: the tile is ahead in 32 of 48 cells, by up to 55 times, and behind in 16, by up to 7.2 times.
svg.title: A grid of speed-ups of the resident tiles over the fastest real software, for multiply, fused multiply-add and add, at four formats, on two machines: the tile is ahead in 32 of 48 cells, by up to 55 times, and behind in 16, by up to 7.2 times.
svg.text: Where the card wins, for every operation
Resident tiles against the fastest real software on the same machine, each at the largest element count both sides
measured (at least 65,536). Green: the tile is ahead. Red: it is behind. The small word is who the software was.
A loss is written as a divisor: /7.2 means the tile takes 7.2 times as long. Fused multiply-add flatters the tile because glibc's fma is a
function call and __float128's is a soft routine; add and multiply are one instruction on a CPU that has the format.
